analyst.summary: MTAR Technologies makes precision components for clean-energy fuel cells/electrolyzers, nuclear power, and aerospace/defence, and just posted its strongest year yet - revenue and profit both growing sharply, helped by a real, order-book-backed relationship as sole hot-box/electrolyzer supplier to US fuel-cell maker Bloom Energy. Management has raised next year's revenue growth guidance to a striking 80%. That said, the stock already trades at roughly 200 times earnings, an extreme multiple for a company whose return on equity is only about 11% today, and a large share of the growth is concentrated in one customer and one fast-moving technology segment - so a lot of very good news is already priced in. We rate this a Hold: a genuine growth story, but not one to add to at this valuation.
